implementation: Accepted WP01 package is controlling body/envelope authority.
Three arms at 0/120/240 degrees; 1 degree stowed and 80 degrees deployed from one solver.
Full stowed containment; no unintended protrusion.
Use WP01 body-owned covers and cover-before-arm sequence.
Retain exact COTS identities unless configuration analysis proves deficiency.
Drawing-derived COTS fallback authorized when primary dimensions are adequate.
Zero-GS backup spring must deploy to stops and positive locks with HBD installed.
Inherited fragmenting fuse rejected; nonfragmenting captive bypass implemented.
Positive mechanical deployed locks; no reliance on residual drive force.
Use provisional 300/500/750 lbf plus 150/1000 lbf sensitivity; not approved loads.
No more than 1.0 mm documented internal-only WP01 relief; none used in this build.
GS, HBD and backup spring replaceable through arm-module service access.
Exact sourced retainers where supported; captive custom headed-pin fallback allowed.
Deliver exactly STOWED and DEPLOYED top-level state assemblies.
Derive new controlled GS extension-force specification.
HBD requires protected/drained cartridge boundary; exposure qualification remains external.
